description: Implementation of the Digital Transformation Project of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although actions have already been taken to develop basic infrastructure and basic information systems relating to information technology of the University of Kelaniya, it has been recognized that it is inadequate to meet the current needs of the higher education sector in the world rapidly evolving into a digital-centric and dynamic environment. Therefore, a project has been planned to be implemented to digitize all the main learning and management processes of the University of Kelaniya, which currently has 16,368 undergraduate students, 1,114 postgraduate students and 56,619 external degree students registered, as well as about 1,700 academic and non-academic staff, within 02 years and to develop the necessary infrastructure for the same. It is expected to achieve benefits such as improving service delivery, attracting a wide range of students and securing financial sustainability by modernizing systems and operations of the University under the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to implement the Digital Transformation Project of the University of Kelaniya, which has been identified under the Public Investment Plan, during the years 2026-2027 at an estimated cost of Rs. 476 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
